    for (label, obj, expected, raw), o in zip(CASES, outs):
        if expected == E_OK:
            if o.get('status') == 'error':
                print('FAIL %-32s expected ok got %s' % (label, o)); bad += 1
        else:
            st, err = expected
            if o.get('status') != st or o.get('error') != err:
                print('FAIL %-32s expected %s got %s' % (label, expected, o)); bad += 1
            elif err == 'invalid_instance':
                want_id = None
                if obj is not None and isinstance(obj, dict) and isinstance(obj.get('id'), str):
                    import re
                    if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,31}', obj['id']):
                        want_id = obj['id']
                if o.get('id') != want_id:
                    print('FAIL %-32s id echo %r want %r' % (label, o.get('id'), want_id)); bad += 1
        if r.stderr and b'Traceback' in r.stderr:
            pass
    if r.stderr:
        sys.stderr.write('child stderr (first 800): ' + r.stderr.decode()[:800])
    print('validation suite: %d cases, %d failures' % (len(CASES), bad))

main()
